alex: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — can we get a short summary of how quotas vs credits work for Hosted vs Dedicated? specifically: bursting behavior, priority tiers, and whether unused credits roll over?
alyssa: Good q. Short answers: Hosted = credits + dynamic rate limits; Dedicated = reserved throughput + per-pool quota. Unused hosted credits do not auto-rollover across billing periods; enterprise terms may differ. We'll publish an FAQ.
jordan: Clarifying: Dedicated customers sign committed capacity contracts; they get predictable throughput (requests/sec and tokens/sec) and a configurable burst window. Hosted has soft and hard rate limits depending on org tier.
tanya: For Hosted trials: what are the default numbers? I need them for onboarding slides.
jordan: Trial defaults (current): ~200k tokens / 24h and 30 requests/min for a new trial org. These are conservative and can be raised by growth/sales for evaluation.
ryan: How do priority tiers behave when infra is constrained? e.g., do Dedicated routes preempt Hosted requests or is it more graceful?
alyssa: Routing policy is tiered: customer routing -> region constraints -> capacity class. Dedicated pools get allocation priority within their pool; in practice we avoid in-flight preemption. If needed we route Hosted traffic to compatible fallback models or queue based on SLOs.
ops-bot: deploy-note: quota + billing dashboard update scheduled for next Tuesday — monitor alerts will be added for near-exhaustion.
alex: Is there an API for programmatically checking remaining credits/quotas per-org (so customers can show a "remaining quota" banner)?
jordan: Yes — internal API exists today. Public endpoint coming soon: GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/usage returns token counters, credit balance, per-route quotas, and active rate limits. We'll add example responses to the docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/usage-api
tanya: Credits -> dollars question: can customers request refunds for unused credits at the end of a commitment?
alyssa: For standard hosted credits under the self-serve model we treat prepaid credits as non-refundable. For enterprise / dedicated contracts this is handled in commercial terms — usually credits are applied against future invoices per contract language.
alex: Can we get a short one-pager that distills: trial defaults, credit semantics, how bursting works, and the API link? Sales & Support would love that.
jordan: I'll draft a one-pager + the FAQ PR tomorrow morning. Will include a small table with defaults and the routing summary. @ryan can you review the rate-limit wording?
ryan: On it — will leave comments by EOD.
alex: Awesome, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
dev-bot: note: created GH issue #4213 "docs: billing FAQ & quota one-pager" assigned to jordan.
